meta.name: ai-orchestration-langchain
meta.description: LangChain.js patterns for building LLM applications — chat models, LCEL chains, prompt templates, structured output, agents, tools, RAG, streaming, and LangSmith tracing

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用LangChain.js开发LLM应用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building LLM applications with LangChain.js

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 LangChain.js 构建 LLM 应用，包括聊天模型、链式调用、结构化输出、智能体、RAG 和流式响应。
howto.when: 当你需要组合多个 LLM 步骤（如提示词→模型→解析器），或需要智能体自动调用工具、实现 RAG 检索时触发。

say.text: 帮我定义一个工具，获取天气，并用 Zod 验证输入参数。
say.note: 会生成 tool() 函数代码。

say.text: 用 createAgent 创建一个研究助手智能体，包含搜索工具。
say.note: 会生成智能体代码并支持流式输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build LLM applications with LangChain.js, including chat models, LCEL chains, structured output, agents, RAG, and streaming.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to compose multi-step LLM workflows (prompt → model → parser), or when you need agentic tool calling, RAG retrieval, or streaming.

say_en.text: Create a LangChain chain that pipes a prompt to GPT-4 and outputs a string.
Define a weather tool with Zod schema for input validation.
Use createAgent to build a research assistant agent with a search tool.
say_en.note: Generates agent code with streaming support.
